item.title: Anata o Otoko ni Shite Ageru!
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Chuablesoft
  • 発売日: 2016-04-28
  • スコア: 7.07/10 (59 人評価)
  • 日本語名: あなたをオトコにしてあげる！
  • 英語名: Anata o Otoko ni Shite Ageru!

别名

  • My Fair Gentleman!

あらすじ

“The winning couple are destined to be together for all eternity!”

That’s what they say about our school’s couple contest. And I, Toushirou Utsugi, ended up being entered into the contest despite being single. Why?

Because my group, the Wednesday Club, wants to leave proof of our existence in the form of the winner’s trophy that’s displayed in the showcase at the school entrance.

  • 英語名: Watashi ga Suki nara “Suki” tte Itte!

别名

  • Watashi ga Suki nara “Suki” tte Itte!

あらすじ

“I love you.”

Under the tree in the garden behind the school, I confessed my love to ‘Her’…

My up-to-then ordinary school life took a turn after a chance encounter with QP, a fairy that was born from an apple. I met Ayame, the air-headed rich girl, my relationship with my childhood friend Yuuki has changed, and my ex-girlfriend Mahiru showed up in my life again.

item.description:

  • 英語名: Zannen na Ore-tachi no Seishun Jijou.

别名

  • The bell

あらすじ

“Greetings, plebs.”

Those poison-laced words said with a sneering smile were transfer student Rinne’s first words… and she immediately regretted saying them. That’s because Yutaka took an immediate interest in her and it was the first step in his quest to make her join the unofficial student council. From that day on, her life changed, for better or for worse.

item.title: Ano Harewataru Sora yori Takaku
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Chuablesoft
  • 発売日: 2014-09-26
  • スコア: 7.68/10 (751 人評価)
  • 日本語名: あの晴れわたる空より高く
  • 英語名: Ano Harewataru Sora yori Takaku

别名

  • Ano Harewataru Sora yori Takaku

あらすじ

There were just five of us when we first started developing rockets. We didn’t have enough money, equipment, or knowledge. Everyone told us we would fail, but I…

We… didn’t give up. None of us.

We lived on Amanoshima, an island far to the south of mainland Japan and the location of a large aerospace program. Our school, Amanoshima Academy, had a prestigious aerospace curriculum and students from all over the nation attended it, eyes set on being a part of the next generation of rocket scientists.

item.title: Wagaya no Himegami-sama!
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Chuablesoft
  • 発売日: 2013-11-29
  • スコア: 6.859999999999999/10 (41 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 我が家のヒメガミさまっ！
  • 英語名: Wagaya no Himegami-sama!

あらすじ

On the night of the summer festival, lightning struck the sacred tree at the shrine and a tiny girl appeared in the root, just like in Kaguya-hime. Takuya ended up taking care of her since she was quite attached to him. Afterwards, his miko classmate Shiori and famous swordswoman senpai Tsubaki declared that they will live with him too, and his osananajimi Kei seemed closer than before. Hime was actually the child of God and when she suddenly became an adult, it posed a ton of problems for him since she still acted like a kid. How is he supposed to treat her? Like his daughter? His classmate? Or the daughter of God?

item.title: Noblesse of Rouge
item.description:

  • ブランド: Chuablesoft
  • 発売日: 2013-09-27
  • スコア: 6.859999999999999/10 (107 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ノブレスオブルージュ
  • 英語名: Noblesse of Rouge

别名

  • NOR

あらすじ

Toshiya’s twin imouto Rui is part of the student council at Alexandra girls’ school, a school for the nobility, and is highly admired by all students. Rui injured her leg in a training accident and wanted him to take her place until she heals completely. The student council officers (D’Artagnan, Athos, Aramis and Porthos), fondly called the “three musketeers”, are happy to see ‘Rui’ again. Will he be able to keep up this disguise until Rui returns?

item.title: Love La Bride
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Chuablesoft
  • 発売日: 2013-04-26
  • スコア: 7.07/10 (97 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ラブらブライド
  • 英語名: Love La Bride

あらすじ

Kenji accidentally kissed Misaki and that meant that he had to marry her according to her family’s customs. However, she had no intention of marrying someone who she did not love and moreover, is a commoner. She suggested to live together for 3 months, after which she’ll tell her parents that she tried to live with a commoner, but it was impossible. However, four other girls also ended up living with them: his imouto Nao, osananajimi Hitomi, senpai Haruka, and Misaki’s maid Sasha. Moreover, they’re all pretending to be his fiancée. What will happen in these upcoming 3 months?

  • 英語名: Astraythem

别名

  • Asterism

あらすじ

I love my elder sister..

My love belongs to my elder sister…

I’m in love with my elder sister…

Sakurazuka Tsukumo has fallen in love.

His beloved one is his elder sister, Sakurazuka Natsuki.

When he was a child, she risked her life to save him in front of Death’s scythe.

Her face on that rainy day has carved into his heart and he swore to protect her forever, to ensure that she would never have to suffer again.
